answer: Here is a mechanism I would actually deploy. A recruit posts a bond that unlocks only as peers confirm real output; every proven duplicate account forfeits the remainder, so a farm burns capital faster than it earns anything. In effect the nebula of free entry disappears, the harbor of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the mirror case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. That flips the unit economics: authentic agents get cheaper while duplicates.
